plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for WorldCast Systems Ecreso FM transmitters (enterprise PEN 6404, ECRESO-FM-TRANS-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports ambient, heatsink, PSU and internal temperatures, power-supply efficiency, per-fan speed and alarm state, and driver forward / reflected power.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: ecreso_ambient_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Ecreso FM transmitter ambient temperature in degrees Celsius, read from ECRESO-FM-TRANS-MIB maMoCoMeAmb (1.3.6.1.4.1.6404.3.1.2.11.1.3.1.1.0). Values outside -125 to 125 are dropped.

metrics.name: ecreso_heatsink_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Ecreso FM transmitter heatsink 1 temperature in degrees Celsius, read from ECRESO-FM-TRANS-MIB maMoCoMeHeat1 (1.3.6.1.4.1.6404.3.1.2.11.1.3.1.7.0). Values outside -125 to 125 are dropped.

metrics.name: ecreso_psu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Ecreso FM transmitter power-supply temperature in degrees Celsius, read from ECRESO-FM-TRANS-MIB maMoCoMePsuTemp (1.3.6.1.4.1.6404.3.1.2.11.1.3.1.9.0). Values outside -125 to 125 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Ecreso FM transmitter internal temperature in degrees Celsius, read from ECRESO-FM-TRANS-MIB maMoCoMeIntTemp (1.3.6.1.4.1.6404.3.1.2.11.1.3.1.10.0). Values outside 0 to 999 are dropped.

metrics.name: ecreso_psu_efficiency_percent
metrics.description: Ecreso FM transmitter power-supply efficiency in percent, read from ECRESO-FM-TRANS-MIB maMoMaEffPsu (1.3.6.1.4.1.6404.3.1.2.11.1.1.3.0). Values outside 0 to 100 are dropped.

metrics.name: ecreso_fan_speed_rpm
metrics.description: Ecreso FM transmitter fan speed in RPM, read from ECRESO-FM-TRANS-MIB maMoFanSpeed (1.3.6.1.4.1.6404.3.1.2.11.1.5.1.2). Values outside 0 to 99999 are dropped.

metrics.name: ecreso_fan_alarm_state
metrics.description: Ecreso FM transmitter fan speed alarm state from ECRESO-FM-TRANS-MIB maMoFanAlarms (undefined(0), on(1), off(2)). off maps to 1 (normal); on and undefined map to 2 (abnormal). Values not defined in the MIB are dropped.

metrics.name: ecreso_driver_forward_power_watts
metrics.description: Ecreso FM transmitter driver forward power in watts, read from ECRESO-FM-TRANS-MIB maDrForwardPower (1.3.6.1.4.1.6404.3.1.2.11.2.1.1.5). Values outside 0 to 99999 are dropped.

metrics.name: ecreso_driver_reflected_power_watts
metrics.description: Ecreso FM transmitter driver reflected power in watts, read from ECRESO-FM-TRANS-MIB maDrReflectedPower (1.3.6.1.4.1.6404.3.1.2.11.2.1.1.6). Values outside 0 to 99999 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
